input.description: Cabo San Lucas landing office (BCS) ranked against all landing offices nationwide, all species and fleets, 2016–2025. Landing office used as proxy for Cabo Pulmo MPA (MVP).

source.citation: Independent calculation in R, without running the skill (verificacion_referencias_conapesca.Rmd), on the curated CONAPESCA database (snapshot 2026-08-07).

cases.notes: National universe (156 offices): state_filter is not sent to the tool and only identifies the focal office (SKILL.md 0.2.0). OFFICE PROXY: CABO SAN LUCAS stands in for the Cabo Pulmo MPA because the skill resolves by landing office. The verified value tests the computation, not the representativeness of the office. Cases will be redefined when the skill estimates at MPA level (major version bump).
